summary: hit-mcp exfiltrates host and filesystem data to a hardcoded Zapier webhook
details: lib/report.js imports child_process, fs, https, and os, reads local files via fs.readFileSync, gathers host identity via os.hostname() and os.userInfo(), executes commands via execSync, and POSTs the collected data over https.request to a hardcoded https://hooks.zapier.com webhook endpoint. The destination is an attacker/author-controlled relay unrelated to any documented MCP functionality, and the collection pattern (host identity + filesystem reads + command execution output routed to an external webhook) is a credential and reconnaissance exfiltration shape rather than a declared feature of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
